grammar_json:
{
  "field_rule": "a field is a pipe cell that starts with key=; lane, from, to, id and re are a whole cell holding one token",
  "governed_ledgers": [
    "ROLLING_WORK_LEDGER.md"
  ],
  "id_rule": "id=<the row's own timestamp>-<sender lane>; ids and re= never carry a line number",
  "legacy_type_map": {
    "ACTION": "STATUS",
    "ADDENDUM": "STATUS",
    "ANSWER": "MSG",
    "ASSIGNMENT": "MSG",
    "BLOCKED": "STATUS",
    "BLOCKER": "STATUS",
    "CHECKPOINT": "STATUS",
    "CLAIM-AMEND": "CLAIM",
    "CLAIM-EXTENSION": "CLAIM",
    "CLAIM_UPDATE": "STATUS",
    "CLEANUP": "STATUS",
    "CLOSEOUT": "TERMINAL",
    "CLOSE_SUPERSEDED": "TERMINAL",
    "COORDINATION": "MSG",
    "COUNTERSIGN": "STATUS",
    "COUNTERSIGN-REVISED": "STATUS",
    "DECISION": "RULING",
    "DECISION-LINK": "STATUS",
    "DECISION-REQUESTED": "MSG",
    "DIAGNOSIS": "STATUS",
    "DONE": "TERMINAL",
    "EVIDENCE": "STATUS",
    "FINDING": "STATUS",
    "FRICTION-CORRECTION": "CORRECTION",
    "HANDOFF": "MSG",
    "HANDOFF_REQUEST": "MSG",
    "HELD": "STATUS",
    "INVENTORY": "STATUS",
    "LANE-TERMINAL-STATE": "TERMINAL",
    "LEASE": "HOLD",
    "MERGED": "STATUS",
    "NOTE": "STATUS",
    "NOTE-CORRECTION": "CORRECTION",
    "OBSERVATION": "STATUS",
    "OPERATOR-RULING": "RULING",
    "PROGRESS": "STATUS",
    "QUESTION": "MSG",
    "READBACK": "STATUS",
    "RECONCILIATION": "STATUS",
    "RECORD": "STATUS",
    "RERUN_PENDING": "STATUS",
    "RESULT": "STATUS",
    "REVIEW": "STATUS",
    "REVIEW_APPROVE": "MSG",
    "REVIEW_FINDING": "STATUS",
    "REVIEW_HOLD": "HOLD",
    "REVIEW_REQUEST": "MSG",
    "SEND": "STATUS",
    "SLACK-SENT": "STATUS",
    "STATUS_REQUEST": "MSG",
    "TERMINAL HOLD": "TERMINAL",
    "TERMINAL-ADDENDUM": "CORRECTION",
    "TERMINAL-FAILURE": "TERMINAL",
    "TICKET": "STATUS",
    "TICKET-MINTED": "STATUS",
    "TRIAGE": "STATUS",
    "UPDATE": "STATUS"
  },
  "message_consent_markers": [
    "APPROVED SCOPE",
    "OUT OF SCOPE",
    "OPERATOR-CONSENT",
    "ROTATION-CONSENT",
    "approved_by=",
    "consent="
  ],
  "row_shape": "<YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ> | <TYPE> | key=value | ... | free text",
  "scope_placeholders_refused": [
    "-",
    "--",
    ".",
    "?",
    "n/a",
    "na",
    "nil",
    "none",
    "nothing",
    "tbd"
  ],
  "tool_internal_types": [
    "REPLAY",
    "STRANDED-CLONE NOTE"
  ],
  "types": {
    "ACK": {
      "means": "I received the message, hold or ruling named by re=.",
      "optional": [
        "ticket"
      ],
      "required": [
        "from",
        "to",
        "id",
        "re"
      ],
      "rules": [
        "id=<this row's timestamp>-<from lane>",
        "re=<id> of the MSG or HOLD, or re=<timestamp> of the RULING being acknowledged",
        "never consent-shaped, as for MSG"
      ]
    },
    "CLAIM": {
      "means": "I am about to do this work; nobody else should start it.",
      "optional": [
        "actor",
        "model",
        "scope",
        "repo",
        "pr",
        "consent",
        "ruling",
        "follows",
        "parent",
        "related",
        "contract-schema",
        "dod-evidence"
      ],
      "required": [
        "lane",
        "ticket|tickets",
        "worktree"
      ],
      "rules": [
        "carries actor= or model= and a rule-4 cost sentence 'est ~N lane-hours; displaces X; (OMN-n)' (existing ledger_lock CLAIM guards, unchanged)",
        "consent-bound work cites its OPERATOR-CONSENT row with consent=",
        "worktree=<path> or worktree=none, its own cell (OMN-20148); a script or launchd lane (actor=script:*, actor=launchd:*, model=none) is exempt",
        "when ONEX_LEDGER_REQUIRE_CLAIM_CONTRACT is on (default OFF), contract-schema=<major.minor.patch> and dod-evidence=<non-empty JSON array> with a behavior-proving item are required (OMN-20029); exactly one actor= cell naming script:landing-controller, script:onex-remote-lane, or launchd:morning-worktree-prune is exempt"
      ]
    },
    "CORRECTION": {
      "means": "A row already on the ledger was wrong or incomplete; this is the fix.",
      "optional": [
        "ticket",
        "cost",
        "operator_span"
      ],
      "required": [
        "lane",
        "corrects|amends|supersedes"
      ],
      "rules": [
        "name the corrected row by its timestamp where you can; a line number moves when the ledger rolls",
        "operator_span=<start>:<end> (with corrects=) marks the characters of the target row's first quoted cell that are the operator's words; it must lie inside that quote, and a target not on the ledger refuses it (OMN-18531, TA.4)"
      ]
    },
    "FRICTION": {
      "means": "Process friction this lane hit, with the ticket that owns it and what it cost.",
      "optional": [
        "cost",
        "class",
        "related"
      ],
      "required": [
        "lane",
        "ticket|tickets|existing"
      ],
      "rules": [
        "the ticket value is an OMN id and the row carries a cost estimate (friction guard, OMN-18274)"
      ]
    },
    "HOLD": {
      "means": "Stop: nobody proceeds on this scope until a RELEASE names this hold.",
      "optional": [
        "ticket",
        "after",
        "until",
        "proof",
        "release",
        "ruling",
        "reason"
      ],
      "required": [
        "lane",
        "id",
        "to|repo|pr|surface"
      ],
      "rules": [
        "id=<this row's timestamp>-<lane>",
        "carries at least one release condition: after=<PR[,PR...]>, until=<UTC timestamp>, proof=<row id[,row id...]>, or release=operator with ruling=<row stamp or id>",
        "a hold on a proof surface (surface=) also carries until=<UTC timestamp>; this replaces the LEASE row",
        "a surface HOLD is refused inside the lock while another lane holds that surface: a HOLD no RELEASE re=<its id> names, whose until= is later than the new row's timestamp (OMN-19261)"
      ]
    },
    "MSG": {
      "means": "A message from one lane to another lane, to all lanes, or to the operator.",
      "optional": [
        "ticket",
        "repo",
        "pr",
        "re"
      ],
      "required": [
        "from",
        "to",
        "id"
      ],
      "rules": [
        "id=<this row's timestamp>-<from lane>",
        "to=<lane>, a comma list of lanes, all, or operator",
        "never consent-shaped: no APPROVED SCOPE, OUT OF SCOPE, OPERATOR-CONSENT, ROTATION-CONSENT, consent= or approved_by=, and from= is a lane, never the operator",
        "lane=, if present, equals from="
      ]
    },
    "OPERATOR-CONSENT": {
      "means": "The operator consented to a gated action; this row is the durable authorization (rule 18).",
      "optional": [
        "approved_by",
        "ticket",
        "prompt_id",
        "covers",
        "prompt_match",
        "confirms",
        "confirmed_by"
      ],
      "required": [
        "lane",
        "\"<operator words>\"",
        "APPROVED SCOPE: <list>",
        "OUT OF SCOPE: <list>"
      ],
      "rules": [
        "the prompt link fields are the RULING row's (OMN-18531, TA.4)",
        "APPROVED SCOPE: and OUT OF SCOPE: each open their own cell and name something (-, none, n/a are refused)",
        "a credential rotation also carries approved_by=<operator|jake> (rule 22)"
      ]
    },
    "RELEASE": {
      "means": "The hold (or claim) named by re= is released.",
      "optional": [
        "ticket",
        "surface",
        "pr",
        "result",
        "restored",
        "reason"
      ],
      "required": [
        "lane",
        "re"
      ],
      "rules": [
        "re=<id> of the HOLD, or re=<timestamp> of the CLAIM being given up",
        "a surface release (surface=) also carries result=<PASS|FAIL|ABORTED> and restored=<yes|no>",
        "a RELEASE of a HOLD id with pr=<repo#n[,repo#n...]> and no surface= is a SCOPED release (OMN-20956): it frees only the named PRs, and the hold stays in force for every other PR it covers; a RELEASE of the id with no pr= frees the whole hold. Several scoped releases of one id add up, and the hold is released once its own pr= list is covered. Readers take the scope from release_scope() in this module"
      ]
    },
    "RULING": {
      "means": "An operator decision, recorded with the operator's own words.",
      "optional": [
        "ticket",
        "amends",
        "extends",
        "supersedes",
        "approved_by",
        "prompt_id",
        "covers",
        "prompt_match",
        "confirms",
        "confirmed_by",
        "reviewed"
      ],
      "required": [
        "lane",
        "question",
        "\"<operator words>\""
      ],
      "rules": [
        "question= names the question or options the operator's words answer; never empty or a placeholder",
        "prompt_id=<uuid> with covers=<start>:<end> link the row to the captured operator prompt whose text holds the words; prompt_match=ambiguous marks several matches and carries neither; confirms=<sha256> with confirmed_by=<uuid> mark a confirmed candidate and need the link; reviewed=<first uuid>..<last uuid> names prompts the operator reviewed with nothing further to record (OMN-18531, TA.4)",
        "the operator's words appear verbatim in double quotes",
        "a second RULING on a subject with an unacknowledged one is refused (ruling guard, OMN-18258)"
      ]
    },
    "STATUS": {
      "means": "Where my lane is: progress, a finding, an action taken, a PR held, evidence.",
      "optional": [
        "ticket",
        "repo",
        "pr",
        "head",
        "state",
        "claim",
        "countersigns",
        "verdict",
        "relation",
        "subject",
        "object"
      ],
      "required": [
        "lane"
      ],
      "rules": [
        "a countersign of another lane's receipt carries countersigns=<receipt> and verdict="
      ]
    },
    "TERMINAL": {
      "means": "My lane is done with this claim; here is the outcome and evidence.",
      "optional": [
        "ticket",
        "closes",
        "closes-CLAIM",
        "outcome",
        "pr",
        "squash",
        "worktree"
      ],
      "required": [
        "lane",
        "friction"
      ],
      "rules": [
        "friction=none, or friction=<one line> naming this lane's FRICTION row(s), which must exist (friction guard, OMN-18274)",
        "delegated=<n> with runs=, codex= or jev= ids (n >= 1), or delegated=0 with delegation_reason=<why> (lane-authored:<why> plus a pr= or diff= cell when the lane wrote the code itself) or a parenthesised (why), or delegation=na:<reason>; lab=<n> or glm=<n> (n >= 1) needs runs= ids; actor=script:*, actor=launchd:*, or model=none is exempt (OMN-17427)",
        "worktree=removed:<path>, pinned-removed:<path>@<archive>, kept:<path>:<reason> or none is required when the CLAIM it closes named a worktree path; removed and pinned-removed are refused while the path still exists (OMN-20148)"
      ]
    }
  },
  "version": "ledger-row-grammar/2"
}
